verses.text: An oracle concerning Nineveh. The book of the vision of Nahum of Elkosh.

blocks.text: An oracle concerning Nineveh. The book of the vision of Nahum of Elkosh.

verses.text: The LORD is a jealous and avenging God;

blocks.text: The LORD is a jealous and avenging God;
the LORD is avenging and wrathful;
the LORD takes vengeance on his adversaries
and keeps wrath for his enemies.

verses.text: The LORD is slow to anger and great in power,

blocks.text: The LORD is slow to anger and great in power,
and the LORD will by no means clear the guilty.
His way is in whirlwind and storm,
and the clouds are the dust of his feet.

verses.text: He rebukes the sea and makes it dry;

blocks.text: He rebukes the sea and makes it dry;
he dries up all the rivers;

verses.text: The mountains quake before him;

blocks.text: the world and all who dwell in it.

verses.text: Who can stand before his indignation?

blocks.text: Who can stand before his indignation?
Who can endure the heat of his anger?
His wrath is poured out like fire,
and the rocks are broken into pieces by him.

verses.text: The LORD is good,

blocks.text: a stronghold in the day of trouble;
he knows those who take refuge in him.

verses.text: But with an overflowing flood

blocks.text: he will make a complete end of the adversaries,
and will pursue his enemies into darkness.

verses.text: What do you plot against the LORD?

blocks.text: What do you plot against the LORD?
He will make a complete end;
trouble will not rise up a second time.

verses.text: For they are like entangled thorns,

blocks.text: For they are like entangled thorns,
they are consumed like stubble fully dried.

verses.text: From you came one

blocks.text: who plotted evil against the LORD,

verses.text: Thus says the LORD,

blocks.text: “Though they are at full strength and many,
they will be cut down and pass away.
I will afflict you no more.

verses.text: And now I will break his yoke from off you

blocks.text: And now I will break his yoke from off you
and will burst your bonds apart.”

verses.text: The LORD has given commandment about you:

blocks.text: The LORD has given commandment about you:
“No more shall your name be perpetuated;
from the house of your gods I will cut off
the carved image and the metal image.
I will make your grave, for you are vile.”

verses.text: Behold, upon the mountains, the feet of him

blocks.text: Behold, upon the mountains, the feet of him
for never again shall the worthless pass through you;

verses.text: The scatterer has come up against you.

blocks.text: The scatterer has come up against you.

verses.text: For the LORD is restoring the majesty of Jacob

blocks.text: For the LORD is restoring the majesty of Jacob

verses.text: The shield of his mighty men is red;

blocks.text: The shield of his mighty men is red;
his soldiers are clothed in scarlet.
The chariots come with flashing metal
on the day he musters them;

verses.text: The chariots race madly through the streets;

blocks.text: The chariots race madly through the streets;
they rush to and fro through the squares;

verses.text: He remembers his officers;

blocks.text: the siege tower is set up.

verses.text: The river gates are opened;
its mistress is stripped; she is carried off,

blocks.text: its mistress is stripped; she is carried off,

verses.text: Nineveh is like a pool
Plunder the silver,

blocks.text: There is no end of the treasure
or of the wealth of all precious things.

verses.text: Desolate! Desolation and ruin!
Where is the lions’ den,

blocks.text: the feeding place of the young lions,
where the lion and lioness went,
where his cubs were, with none to disturb?

verses.text: The lion tore enough for his cubs

blocks.text: The lion tore enough for his cubs
and strangled prey for his lionesses;
he filled his caves with prey
and his dens with torn flesh.

verses.text: Behold, I am against you, declares the LORD of hosts, and I will burn your chariots in smoke, and the sword shall devour your young lions. I will cut off your prey from the earth, and the voice of your messengers shall no longer be heard.

blocks.text: Behold, I am against you, declares the LORD of hosts, and I will burn your chariots in smoke, and the sword shall devour your young lions. I will cut off your prey from the earth, and the voice of your messengers shall no longer be heard.

verses.text: Woe to the bloody city,

blocks.text: all full of lies and plunder—

verses.text: The crack of the whip, and rumble of the wheel,

blocks.text: The crack of the whip, and rumble of the wheel,

verses.text: Horsemen charging,
And all for the countless whorings of the prostitute,

blocks.text: And all for the countless whorings of the prostitute,
who betrays nations with her whorings,

verses.text: Behold, I am against you,

blocks.text: and will lift up your skirts over your face;
and I will make nations look at your nakedness

verses.text: I will throw filth at you

blocks.text: I will throw filth at you

verses.text: And all who look at you will shrink from you and say,

blocks.text: And all who look at you will shrink from you and say,
“Wasted is Nineveh; who will grieve for her?”
Where shall I seek comforters for you?

verses.text: Are you better than Thebes
Cush was her strength;

blocks.text: Egypt too, and that without limit;
Put and the Libyans were her helpers.

verses.text: Yet she became an exile;

blocks.text: her infants were dashed in pieces
at the head of every street;
for her honored men lots were cast,
and all her great men were bound in chains.

verses.text: You also will be drunken;

blocks.text: you will seek a refuge from the enemy.

verses.text: All your fortresses are like fig trees

blocks.text: All your fortresses are like fig trees
into the mouth of the eater.

verses.text: Behold, your troops

blocks.text: are wide open to your enemies;

verses.text: Draw water for the siege;

blocks.text: take hold of the brick mold!

verses.text: There will the fire devour you;

blocks.text: There will the fire devour you;
the sword will cut you off.
It will devour you like the locust.

verses.text: You increased your merchants

blocks.text: more than the stars of the heavens.
The locust spreads its wings and flies away.

verses.text: Your princes are like grasshoppers,

blocks.text: your scribes like clouds of locusts
when the sun rises, they fly away;
no one knows where they are.

verses.text: Your shepherds are asleep,

blocks.text: Your people are scattered on the mountains

verses.text: There is no easing your hurt;

blocks.text: There is no easing your hurt;
All who hear the news about you
